visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of an adult female on the right and a young girl on the left standing outdoors. The adult woman is talking enthusiastically, her mouth moving and eyes smiling, while the girl looks at the camera. They are positioned in front of a vibrant green building facade with a large window. (2) A brief wide shot captures the exterior of a red brick building on a street corner, featuring a prominent green 'an post' sign and posters on the windows. (3) Indoors, in a brightly lit office-like environment with wooden counters and green ropes, the adult female holds a light-brown crocheted duck. She moves her hands to demonstrate the toy's wings and body while speaking to the camera. (4) The camera zooms in on a piece of white paper with blue handwritten text which the woman holds up. (5) The woman is then seen interacting with green padded envelopes and a flat cardboard box on a wooden desk, sliding the crocheted duck into one of the envelopes. (6) The younger girl is shown at the post office counter, which has a glass partition. She hands the green envelope to a male clerk behind the counter, then turns to the camera, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. (7) The final phase transitions to a digital screen capture of a Facebook post showing images of the duck and the letter, with yellow text overlays appearing over the interface.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Presentation -> Demonstration -> Execution -> Outcome
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video document a personal vlog experience of using an Irish post office (An Post) to send a handmade crocheted duck as a birthday surprise. It functions both as a heartwarming life update and a practical guide for international viewers on the costs and procedures of mailing parcels from Ireland.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While the brand 'An Post' is clearly visible, the video is presented as a personal vlog documenting a daily activity rather than a paid promotion.
